sources.title: Perceptron launches Isaac 0.5 visual AI model for factories and ...
sources.snippet: Perceptron launches Isaac 0.5 visual AI model for factories and warehouses Startup Perceptron, founded by two former Meta researchers, released Isaac 0.5 to help robots navigate industrial spaces and analyze video.

sources.title: Ex-Meta Scientists Launch Isaac 0.5 AI for Industrial Automation
sources.snippet: Perceptron, a startup founded by former Meta AI scientists, has launched Isaac 0.5, an open-weight AI model designed to enable robots to perceive, reason, and act in industrial environments like warehouses and factories. The company raised $21 million in funding.
